_comment: Golden set for app.services.paper_resolver.resolve_papers, authored against the live corpus of project fa2ab869-6b13-4b31-be5e-ff0c22652922 (100 papers). Every title/author/year below was queried from that project's real rows -- none invented. expect_titles is a list of title substrings a correct resolution must produce (order-insensitive); an EMPTY list asserts resolve_papers must return nothing, i.e. fall through to global retrieval -- those negatives are the point of the set, because the resolver's whole safety property is that it never guesses. Consumed by evals/retrieval/resolver_eval.py, which imports the production resolve_papers directly rather than reimplementing it.
